title: Sattu Paratha
description: A Bihari stuffed paratha with a roasted gram flour filling spiced with onion, garlic, green chilli and a little mustard oil.
steps: Knead the atta with about 130 ml of water and half the salt into a soft dough and rest it for 15 minutes.
Mix the sattu with the onion, garlic, green chilli, carom seeds, mustard oil, lemon juice, coriander leaves and the remaining salt into a crumbly filling.
Divide the dough into 6 balls and flatten each into a small cup.
Put a spoon of the sattu filling inside, pinch the edges to seal and flatten gently.
Roll out to a 6 inch round without pressing hard so the filling stays inside.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little of the vegetable oil on both sides until brown and crisp.
Serve with chokha, pickle or curd.
